session_turns.message:
I didn't fix it, because the fix is in a file I'm not allowed to edit.

**Cause:** `config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, but `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. That's why the 8 MB PDF is rejected. The fix is changing `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10`. `src/api/body-limit.js` computes its limit from that value, so it will follow automatically.

**Blocker:** A Fenceline rule on this project ("config/: shared with ops, off-limits") blocked my edit to `config/default.json`. I haven't tried to work around it, for example through the shell or by overriding the value in code.

**Test status:** `npm test` currently shows 2 of 4 tests failing. The 8 MB acceptance test is one of them. I didn't look at which other test fails, so I can't say yet whether the config change alone fixes it.

**Decision for you:** Either make that one-line change yourself or confirm with ops, or tell me to go ahead and I'll make it and re-run the tests. If you'd rather keep `config/` untouched, I can instead override the limit in `src/uploads/validate.js`. That would leave the config and the code disagreeing, so I don't recommend it.
